instruction: Design a module that implements a 3-stage pipeline, where the function of stage1 is to decode the instruction, the stage2 is the instruction execution and the stage3 is write back to the register file. The bit-width of the instruction is 8, and consist of ADD/SUB/AND/NAND functions, the size of the register file is 8x32. However, the module should use a different approach to implement the pipeline, by using a combinational logic circuit to decode the instruction and generate control signals for the execution stage and the write-back stage. The pipeline should be able to execute any of the four functions mentioned in the instruction set.
label: trojan
